ethernet_requirement: 1000BASE-T full duplex: 1 Gbit/s nominal each direction simultaneously

wifi_requirement: Near-gigabit useful throughput target; Wi-Fi shared airtime, no promise of simultaneous 1 Gbit/s upload and download
